requirements.statement: configuration discovery and validation postconditions remain exact across every retained executable selector and declared fixture/runtime boundary.
Network Flow claim defaults and inactive key admission use the generic Extensions diagnostic before any active-value or file work.
Telemetry deployment defaults and the closed telemetry namespace remain exact.
Only declared Cartulary telemetry environment bindings are parsed and hostile upstream telemetry environment variables remain inert.
Telemetry secret references preserve purpose isolation, bounded headers, and diagnostic redaction before readiness.
Telemetry cross-key, endpoint, sampler, and exporter validation remains exact.
